shared_elements: upright figure(s) standing on a horizontal baseline
repeated figures set side by side in a row
curved/hooked terminal forms (boat prow vs. animal heads/limbs)
justification: The only real correspondence is the organising principle of upright figures aligned along a horizontal line or band, with repeated forms set side by side. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat, solid red-painted silhouette of two figures in a crescent-ended vessel on a smooth speckled rock, while B is a deeply carved, multi-register relief on a shaped stone block crowded with animal and bird imagery in low relief.
